displayName: [Preview]: Microsoft Foundry Guardrails should satisfy an ACS policy baseline without automatic changes
description: Check whether an ACS-format Guardrail already satisfies the whole baseline selected by its full ARM resource ID. Deny blocks a noncompliant write without changing the candidate. Audit reports noncompliance without blocking or modifying the Guardrail.

metadata.description: Audit, deny, or disable this requirement.
Full ARM resource ID of the existing accounts/raiPolicies ACS baseline whose entire policy must already be satisfied. This is a resource reference, not a local manifest key or a single-point binding.
